points.quote: Create the decorator with `createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService')`, and give it the same name as the interface: `export const IFooService = createDecorator<IFooService>('fooService');`. The interface and the const share one identifier
put the service parameter after any non-service arguments and mark it with the decorator: constructor(arg: string, @IFooService private readonly fooService: IFooService)
call `instantiationService.createInstance(MyClass, arg)`. Pass only the static arguments, and the service arguments are supplied for you.
Singleton registration is a side-effect import, so the file must be pulled in by an entry-point `import`.
